text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Elevated heart rate, perspiration, and 
facial flushing detected in Flower-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Determining this to be an abnormal status. 
I shall now commence the mission: "Escort 
to the Infirmary."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: W-W-Wait, that's not what this is! Um—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Blessing" from Flower-san confirmed. 
However, I understand this flow was 
already executed inside the room upon 
waking up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Was it weird of me to repeat it so 
many times after all?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Still, when I realized today was your 
special day, Bourbon-san, I just couldn't 
resist telling you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“—However, each time I am celebrated, my 
'Warm & Fuzzy' status effect grows ever 
stronger.”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I have deemed no correction of 
Flower-san's words or actions necessary. 
Thank you for assisting in boosting my 
stats.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so...? In that case, one more 
time...! Bourbon-san, happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirmed an increase in the "Warm and 
Fuzzy" status. ...It appears there is no 
upper limit.
